passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent
passages.note: Chaptered text lists Rubio as Senate coauthor; operative Section 220.5 forbids school rules that require disclosure without the pupil's consent, and 220.3 only removes a duty to disclose rather than mandating secrecy.
Aye on Senate final passage of the Senate-amended text, 29-8 (about 22% No, not near-unanimous).

rows.reasoning: Rubio coauthored and voted Aye (29-8) on AB 1955 (2023-2024), whose operative Section 220.5 bars any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require staff to disclose a pupil's gender identity without the pupil's consent, matching "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents." The bill does not require staff to withhold the information (it only removes a requirement to disclose), so "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents" is not established.
